title: State reset in Deal Paperwork fees table upon navigating to Carrier Shipment tab
preconditions: User logged into CRM as Sales Manager. Deal #9482 opened with $42,850 calculated paperwork fees.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Navigate to Deals > Pipeline > Open Deal #9482.
2. Verify active paperwork shows itemized accessory fee ($850.00) and Total = $42,850.00.
3. Click 'Carrier Shipment' tab to review delivery dispatch.
5. Observe the accessories table and total calculation field.
expectedBehavior: The paperwork state and line items should persist in memory/cache across tab switches within the same deal session.
actualBehavior: Navigating away unmounts component without syncing draft state, causing the accessories table to clear and resetting the calculation total to base MSRP.
businessImpact: High risk of sales reps sending inaccurate or discounted contracts to car buyers during live desk negotiations.
rootCause: React tab state was re-initializing from URL search params without reading unsaved local state cache.
fixVerification: State persistence hook implemented with local storage fallback; verified across Chrome, Edge, and Safari.

title: Unread AI Chat filter drops silently when user clicks column sort header
preconditions: Lead inbox contains mixed unread and read conversations.
stepsToReproduce: 3. Verify table filters down to 14 unread leads.
4. Click 'Last Activity' column header to sort descending.
expectedBehavior: Table sorts records by timestamp while keeping 'Unread AI Follow-Up' filter active.
actualBehavior: Sorting query parameter overwrites the filter query parameter (?sort=desc instead of ?filter=unread&sort=desc), reloading all 400+ leads.
businessImpact: BDC reps missed critical hot leads because their prioritized inbox view kept resetting during routine sorting.
rootCause: URL query param builder replaced all search params instead of merging new sort keys with existing filter state.
fixVerification: Updated router hook with query-string merger. Verified sorting works with single and composite filter chips.

title: Embeddable booking modal fails to expand height on iOS Safari iframe container
environment: Production Staging • iPhone 14 Pro / Safari iOS 17.4
preconditions: Befer widget script embedded into third-party HTTPS client website.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Open client booking page on an iPhone running Safari.
2. Select service category and pick tomorrow's date.
3. Tap 2:00 PM time slot to trigger confirmation step.
4. Observe container height and 'Confirm Appointment' CTA.
expectedBehavior: Parent window dynamically resizes iframe container using window.postMessage payload so the entire form is accessible.
actualBehavior: Container remains constrained to fixed 320px height, pushing the confirmation CTA below viewport without allowing vertical scroll.
businessImpact: 100% bounce rate on mobile Safari users attempting to finalize booking confirmations on client websites.
rootCause: ResizeObserver callback was suppressed by iOS Safari cross-origin iframe security policy when document body height recalculated.
fixVerification: Implemented explicit postMessage event listener with client-side polyfill. Verified across iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile, and iPadOS.

title: Backend email worker crashed on CSV leads containing unescaped apostrophes in names
preconditions: Workspace admin uploading lead contact lists for active sequence campaigns.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Prepare CSV with lead names such as "Patrick O'Connor" or "Sarah D'Angelo".
2. Upload via Campaign > Add Contacts > CSV Import.
expectedBehavior: All names properly sanitized and stored; campaign sequence dispatches smoothly to all imported leads.
actualBehavior: Apostrophe caused raw SQL string interpolation failure in email template compiler, crashing worker process and dropping remaining queue.
businessImpact: Critical data loss: entire batches of prospect emails failed to send, leaving campaigns stalled.
rootCause: Dynamic template string replacement bypassed parameterized query sanitization in the email template engine.
fixVerification: Added parameterized template variable sanitizer and automated Postman test with multi-lingual edge case strings.
